learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn how to stay safe at home and on the road by following simple rules!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Always hold an adult's hand when walking outside. We must look left and right before crossing the road safely.
We should never play with sharp things or fire. Being smart means knowing what is safe and what is dangerous.

fun_activity.title: 🛑 Red Light Green Light
fun_activity.instructions: Play a game where you freeze when someone says Red Light and walk when they say Green Light to practice road safety!

quick_recap: ⭐ Safety rules keep us protected from harm.
⭐ Never talk to strangers or take things from them.
⭐ Always cross the road at the zebra crossing.
